title: OFFSIDE: Benchmarking Unlearning Misinformation in Multimodal Large Language Models

layout.note: Four borderless tinted cards in a two-by-two grid, each with a coloured header strip (setting title and small icons), three aligned rows Q, GT and A, and an image tile. Tile and header strip swap sides so the layout mirrors: photo at the left in the left column and at the right in the right column, header on top in the upper row and below the rows in the lower row. A round OFFSIDE football badge overlaps the inner corners of the grid; a small legend sits under the lower-left card.

lesson: Give each evaluation setting the same record card, an image tile plus Q, GT and A rows, in its own pastel, and let colour inside the answer text carry the verdict, so settings compare at a glance without ticks or arrows. A logo badge at the centre of the grid ties the cards together.
